confidence_notes: Food anchors (coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) are based on aggregated Kerala cost-of-living listings, though those sites are crowd-sourced, undated, and not Munnar-specific. Beer and wine are less certain: alcohol in Kerala is heavily taxed and served in limited venues, so these are rough estimates. Cocktail is inferred from the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Munnar's hill-station market and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation is the RBA exchange-rate page value I could verify (2026-03-20). It is not confirmed as the latest observation available at the 2026-11-19 generation date, and a later value could not be retrieved within the search budget.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kerala cost-of-living data (Kochi, Perinthalmanna, Thiruvananthapuram, and statewide averages) used for food and drink; Munnar's hill-station tourist pricing applied as a premium for accommodation and mid-range dining.
